REPORT zreg_screen_form.
PARAMETERS p_flag AS CHECKBOX DEFAULT 'X'.
PARAMETERS p_text TYPE c LENGTH 10 MODIF ID txt.
PARAMETERS p_other TYPE c LENGTH 10.
AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  PERFORM adjust_screen.
START-OF-SELECTION.
  WRITE / 'done'.
FORM adjust_screen.
  PERFORM hide_text.
ENDFORM.
FORM hide_text.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'TXT' AND p_flag = 'X'.
      screen-active = '0'.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
    IF screen-name = 'P_OTHER'.
      screen-required = '2'.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
